All 14/14 backend pytest tests pass against the production domain (root, health, config, leads CRUD, appointments CRUD, admin (verify/stats/leads/appointments/contacts/careers/newsletter with 401 without and 200 with X-Admin-Token), contact, newsletter dedupe, careers, chat SSE + history). Server-side JSON-LD in index.html is present with @type=[MedicalBusiness, LocalBusiness], name='CareNest Home Health', url=https://carenesthomehealth.in, +91 9175724546, info@carenesthomehealth.in. Frontend UI verified: home hero 'Professional home healthcare, delivered.', 4 hero CTAs (hero-book-appointment / hero-call-now / hero-whatsapp / hero-emergency), /pricing page shows 'No GST' + 'no hidden charges' badges and 49 ₹ occurrences (22 services), /services/icu-at-home shows ₹4,500/day + lead-form, /locations/delhi-ncr shows map iframe + lead-form, combinatorial /locations/delhi-ncr/icu-at-home returns 200 with ICU+Delhi content, /admin login accepts token 4kZH6CqjGvw-x0q8ezt_48NAeQU7Zo36 and renders Enquiries dashboard with 4 stat cards + all 5 tabs (Leads/Appointments/Contacts/Careers/Newsletter), dark-mode theme-toggle toggles html.dark class, AI chat FAB streams Claude Sonnet 4.5 reply mentioning ₹800 per session for physiotherapy, 4-step /book-appointment flow (Service → Patient → Schedule → Confirm) posts /api/appointments 200 + sonner 'Appointment received. We'll confirm within 15 minutes.'. One PRODUCTION BUG uncovered — see backend_issues.critical.

critical.issue: Home lead form (data-testid=lead-form-home) sends `email: ""` (empty string) when the user leaves the OPTIONAL email field blank. Backend Pydantic rejects empty string with 422 `value is not a valid email address: An email address must have an @-sign.` Sonner shows RED error toast 'Could not submit — please call +91 9175724546.' — real users skipping the optional email will fail to submit a lead. This is a revenue-affecting bug that was missed by backend pytest (which always sends a valid email). Reproduced twice with different names; POSTing the same payload but with a valid email returns 200 + green success toast.

integration_issues.flow: Home lead form submission when email left blank
integration_issues.issue: Frontend serialises optional email as '' rather than omitting or null-ing it, causing 422 from backend. Fix either (a) in ChatWidget/Home lead form: `const payload = {name, phone, city, service, message, urgency, source:'home'}; if (email) payload.email = email;`  OR  (b) in backend Pydantic model: coerce empty string → None with a validator on the `email` field (`@field_validator('email', mode='before') def blank_to_none(cls,v): return v or None`).

Non-blocking: still logs 'AnalyticsLoader: failed to load config TypeError: Failed to fetch' once at startup in headless Playwright — same benign race observed in iteration_2. Backend endpoint itself returns 200 in curl and pytest. No functional impact.

action_items: HIGH: Fix home lead form empty-email 422 bug. Preferred fix is backend-side (Pydantic pre-validator turning '' into None on `email` for /api/leads, /api/contact, /api/appointments and any other model using EmailStr | None) because the same anti-pattern likely exists in every lead/contact form using the same schema. Verify by POST /api/leads {name, phone, city:'Pune', service:'Home Nursing', email:''} — must return 200, not 422.

rca of the issue: Home lead form (Home.jsx <QuickEnquiry/> or similar): on submit, the payload always contains `email` regardless of whether the user typed anything. The backend Pydantic model for /api/leads uses `email: EmailStr | None = None` (or similar), which via pydantic-v2 rejects '' as an invalid email (v2 no longer treats '' as None). Reproduction: (1) Open https://carenesthomehealth.in/, dismiss banner, scroll to 'Quick enquiry' block, (2) fill Full name + Phone + City=Pune + Service=Home Nursing, LEAVE EMAIL BLANK, click Request callback. Observed: POST /api/leads → 422 with detail 'value is not a valid email address'. Toast: 'Could not submit — please call +91 9175724546.' Mitigation options: (A) Front-end guard: strip empty strings from optional fields before posting, or (B) Back-end validator: coerce '' → None on all EmailStr | None fields (recommended — applies to all forms globally). Confirmed the same request with email='test@example.com' returns 200.
